title: [#DailyK] Peters on the Block : Trot Singer Kim So-You 트로트 가수 김소유
description:
Curious about someone's story?
Every Monday! A time to meet people from various fields and really get to know them.💞
A human journey with Peter✈️


당신의 이야기가 궁금해요.
매주 월요일! 다양한 분야의 사람들을 만나, 마음을 나눠 보는 시간.💞
피터와 함께 떠나는 사람 여행✈️

[🎤Peters on the Block🎤]

📌 Today's guest: Trot Singer Kim So-You 트로트 가수 김소유

We’ll dive into behind-the-scenes stories from her time on 'Miss Trot' and
explore the resurgence of Korean trot music as it enters a new golden era.
